questions.question: How many two-digit numbers are there which ends in 7 and are divisible by 3?
questions.solution:
Divisibility rule of 3 is that if the sum of digits of number is divisible by 3, the number is divisible by 3

The two-digit numbers which end will 7 are 17, 27, 37, 47, 57, 67, 77, 87, 97

Out of these only 27, 57 and 87 have their sum of digits divisible by 3

So only these 3 are divisible by 3

What is the unit's place of 29¹³⁶?
questions.solution:
The last digit of consecutive powers of 9 are 9, 1, 9, 1… and so on

So when 29 is multiplied by itself the last digit will be 1

The unit's place of 29¹³⁶ will be 1

questions.question: P, Q and R together can complete a work in 36 days. If the ratio of efficiency of P, Q and R is 3 : 2 : 1 respectively, then in how many days R alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Let time taken by R alone to complete work be x

Time taken by Q alone to complete work be x/2

Time taken by P alone to complete work be x/3

Total time taken = 36 days

1/x + 2/x + 3/x = 1/36

x = 216

Total time taken by R alone to complete work is 216 days

questions.question: Two pipes A and B can fill an empty tank in 10 hours and 15 hours respectively. Pipe C alone can empty the completely filled tank in 12 hours. First both pipes A and B are opened and after 5 hours pipe C is also opened. What is the total time (in hours) in which the tank will be filled?
questions.solution:
Total work done in 5 hours = (1/10 + 1/15) × 5 = ½ + 1/3 = 5/6

Only 1/6 of the tank is left to be filled

Now when pipe C is opened, 1 hour work = 1/10 + 1/15 - 1/12 = 1/12

Time taken to fill 1/6th of tank = 1/6 × 12 = 2 hours

Total time taken = 5 + 2 = 7 hours

questions.question: The average of 7 consecutive odd numbers is A. If next 4 and previous 3 odd numbers to these 7 odd numbers are also included, then what is the new average of these 14 consecutive odd numbers?
questions.solution:
Sum of n terms of AP = n/2(2a + (n - 1)d) where ‘a’ is first term and ‘d’ is common difference

Let the first odd number be x

Sum of first 7 odd numbers = 7/2(2x + 6 × 2) = 7x + 42

Average of first 7 odd numbers = (7x + 42)/7 = x + 6 = A

New first term in new case = x - 6

Sum of 14 odd numbers = 14/2(2(x - 6) + 13 × 2) = 14(x + 7) = 14x + 98

Average of 14 odd numbers = (14x + 98)/14 = x + 7 = A + 1

questions.question: A shopkeeper claims to sell his goods at cost price but uses a weight of 225 grams for a 250 grams weight. What is the profit percentage for the shopkeeper?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Profit Percentage** = (Error ÷ Weight Sold) × 100

Error = **True Weight** − **False Weight** = 250 g − 225 g = 25 g

Profit % = (25 ÷ 225) × 100

Profit % = (1 ÷ 9) × 100 = 11.11%

**∴ The correct answer is 11.11%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

True Weight = **250 g**

False Weight Used = **225 g**

Claimed Condition = Selling at **Cost Price (CP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6614d8bddb8d20aa91d9bcfa3c11afc85eead8c9699e9dd5e11e947a8ad9f555.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of 1 g of goods be ₹1.

⇒ The shopkeeper claims to sell 250 g at its **CP**, which is ₹250.

⇒ Therefore, the **Selling Price (SP)** of the quantity sold is ₹250.

⇒ However, he actually gives only **225 g** to the customer.

⇒ The **Actual CP** of the quantity sold (225 g) = 225 × 1 = ₹225.

⇒ **Profit** = SP − CP = 250 − 225 = ₹25.

⇒ **Profit Percentage** = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (25 ÷ 225) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (1 ÷ 9) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 11.11%

**∴ The correct answer is 11.11%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

A dealer is dishonest if he uses a weight less than the true weight. The profit is always calculated on the **actual weight** delivered to the customer.

Successive Profit/Loss

If a dealer sells at a **markup of x%** and uses **y% less weight**, the overall profit % = [(100 + x) ÷ (100 − y) − 1] × 100.

Ratio Method for False Weight

The ratio of **CP to SP** can be expressed as: CP/SP = (False Weight) / (True Weight), provided the price per unit remains the same.

If length and breadth of a rectangle are increased by 15% and 20% respectively, then what will be the percentage increase in area?
questions.solution:
Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

Let the length and breadth of a rectangle be l and b respectively

New length = l + (15/100) × l = 115l/100

New breath = b + (20/100) × b = 120b/100

New area = (115 × 120)lb/10000 = 1.38lb

Percentage increase in area = (1.38lb - lb)/lb × 100 = 38%

questions.question: A boat can row 35 km upstream in 7 hours and the same distance downstream in 5 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of boat in still water be x km/hr

Speed of stream = y km/hr

Speed upstream = (x - y) km/hr

(x - y) = 35/7 = 5 ----(1)

Speed downstream = (x + y) km/hr

(x + y) = 35/5 = 7 ----(2)

From (1) and (2), we get x = 6 km/hr

Speed of boat in still water = 6 km/hr

Time taken = 80 seconds

Speed = Distance/Time = 1600/80 = 20 m/sec

questions.question: Rajeev invested Rs. 4500 for 2 years at compound interest in a company which paid him interest of Rs. 1980. What will be the rate of interest (in percent) at which Rajeev invested his money?
questions.solution:
The formula for CI at annual compound interest, including principal sum, is: {{CI}} = {{P}}{( {1 + frac{{{r}}}{{100 times {{n}}}}} ){{ⁿt}}} - {{P}}

Where:

CI = Compound InterestP = the principal investment amount (the initial deposit or loan amount)r = the annual interest rate (decimal)n = the number of times that interest is compounded per yeart = the number of years the money is invested or borrowed for

Let the rate of interest be r

CI for Rajeev = (4500(1 + r/100)² - 4500) = Rs. 1980

(1 + r/100)² = (1980 + 4500)/4500

(1 + r/100)² = 1.44

1 + r/100 = 1.2

⇒ r = 20%

questions.question: If x + 4 is a factor of 3x² + kx + 8 then what is the value of k?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

If p(x) be a function and (x - a) be a factor of p(x) then, p(a) = 0

**Calculation:**

x + 4 is a factor of 3x² + kx + 8, so x = -4 will be a solution of this equation

⇒ 3(-4)² + k(-4) + 8 = 0

⇒ 4k = 48 + 8

**⇒ k = 14**

questions.question:
In the given figure, ∠BAC = 70°, ∠ACB = 45° and ∠DEA = 140°. What is the value of ∠BDE?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10584d93702c32807004f2264b66022c2f32c9041a14c6b14b22850448f6a250.png]
questions.solution:
Sum of angles of a triangle is 180°

∠ABC + 70 + 45 = 180

∠ABC = 65°

Now, By using Alternate angle theorem, we get

∠DBE = 180 - ∠ABC = 180 - 65 = 115°

∠DEB = 180 - 140 = 40°

∠BDE = 180 - 40 - 115 = 25°
